anchor: the foundation models beat every baseline in all twenty cells
claim_text: Foundation models outperform every baseline in all twenty resolution-signal cells.

adjudication.observed: EWMA baseline outperforms all foundation models in 2 cells: ctx/1min (ewma 0.3827355809461447 vs best FM toto 0.38482784156650457) and images/1min (ewma 0.47926549309674765 vs best FM timesfm 0.4826379762334363) when evaluating individual forecast horizons in forecast_metrics. Under the restricted point-forecast aggregate over horizons (h = -1, span = 'common', candidate = 'point'), foundation models win in all 20 cells.
adjudication.evidence: EWMA baseline achieves a lower WAPE than the best foundation model in the ctx/1min and images/1min cells at shorter horizons.
adjudication.fix: Qualify the claim to specify that it holds for aggregate point forecasts (h = -1, span = 'common', candidate = 'point'), or amend the text to state that foundation models outperform every baseline in 18 of the 20 cells, with EWMA slightly leading at the coarser 1-minute resolution.
adjudication.query: SELECT variate, resolution, MIN(wape) FILTER (WHERE model IN ('naive', 'ewma', 'holt_winters')) AS best_baseline_wape, MIN(wape) FILTER (WHERE model IN ('chronos', 'timesfm', 'toto')) AS best_fm_wape FROM provenance.forecast_metrics GROUP BY variate, resolution HAVING MIN(wape) FILTER (WHERE model IN ('naive', 'ewma', 'holt_winters')) < MIN(wape) FILTER (WHERE model IN ('chronos', 'timesfm', 'toto')) ORDER BY variate, resolution;

adjudication.observed: 20 denominator cells; 20 winning cells; 0 exceptions. Each of the 5 foundation-model/mode configurations wins 20 of 20 common-span aggregate point-WAPE cells. There are 41 current predictor sources and 0 current sources marked superseded; forecast_metrics has no is_current, is_superseded, or effective column.
adjudication.evidence: On common-span aggregate point WAPE (h=-1), every foundation-model configuration is below the best of naive, EWMA, and Holt-Winters in all 20 resolution-signal cells.
adjudication.query:
WITH current_predictors AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS n_current,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE superseded_by IS NOT NULL) AS n_current_superseded
  FROM provenance.v_dim
  WHERE is_current = true AND experiment = 'predictors'
), control_columns AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE column_name = 'is_current') AS has_is_current,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE column_name = 'is_superseded') AS has_is_superseded,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE column_name LIKE '%effective%') AS has_effective
  FROM information_schema.columns
  WHERE table_schema = 'provenance' AND table_name = 'forecast_metrics'
), baseline AS (
  SELECT span, h, resolution, variate, min(wape) AS best_baseline_wape
  FROM provenance.forecast_metrics
  WHERE candidate = 'point' AND mode = 'uni'
    AND model IN ('naive','ewma','holt_winters')
  GROUP BY span, h, resolution, variate
), fm_rows AS (
  SELECT f.span, f.h, f.resolution, f.variate, f.model, f.mode, f.wape,
         b.best_baseline_wape
  FROM provenance.forecast_metrics f
  JOIN baseline b USING (span, h, resolution, variate)
  WHERE f.candidate = 'point'
    AND f.model IN ('chronos','timesfm','toto')
), headline_cells AS (
  SELECT resolution, variate,
         min(wape) AS best_fm_wape,
         min(best_baseline_wape) AS best_baseline_wape
  FROM fm_rows
  WHERE span = 'common' AND h = -1
  GROUP BY resolution, variate
), config_breakdown AS (
  SELECT model, mode, count(*) AS cells,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE wape < best_baseline_wape) AS wins
  FROM fm_rows
  WHERE span = 'common' AND h = -1
  GROUP BY model, mode
), span_h_breakdown AS (
  SELECT span, h, count(*) AS cells,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE best_fm_wape < best_baseline_wape) AS wins
  FROM (
    SELECT span, h, resolution, variate,
           min(wape) AS best_fm_wape,
           min(best_baseline_wape) AS best_baseline_wape
    FROM fm_rows
    GROUP BY span, h, resolution, variate
  ) x
  GROUP BY span, h
)
SELECT p.n_current, p.n_current_superseded,
       c.has_is_current, c.has_is_superseded, c.has_effective,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM headline_cells) AS denominator_cells,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM headline_cells WHERE best_fm_wape < best_baseline_wape) AS winning_cells,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM headline_cells WHERE best_fm_wape >= best_baseline_wape) AS exceptions,
       (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY model, mode) FROM config_breakdown x) AS per_model_mode,
       (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY span, h) FROM span_h_breakdown x) AS per_span_horizon
FROM current_predictors p CROSS JOIN control_columns c
